name: India-UAE CEPA
key_benefits: Duty-free access to 90% of India's exports to UAE by value.
origin_criteria: Wholly obtained or value addition of at least 40% along with change in tariff heading.

name: India-ASEAN FTA
origin_criteria: Regional Value Content (RVC) of not less than 35% of FOB value and Change in Tariff Sub-Heading (CTSH).

name: India-Japan CEPA
key_benefits: Tariff elimination on 90% of tariff lines.
origin_criteria: Qualifying Value Content (QVC) of 35% and Change in Tariff Heading (CTH).

name: India-Korea CEPA
key_benefits: Tariff elimination on 85% of tariff lines.
origin_criteria: Regional Value Content (RVC) of 35% and Change in Tariff Sub-Heading (CTSH).

name: India-Australia ECTA
key_benefits: Zero duty on 100% of tariff lines.
origin_criteria: Wholly obtained or Value addition of 35% with Change in Tariff Sub-Heading (CTSH).

name: SAFTA
origin_criteria: Value addition of 30-40% depending on LDC/non-LDC status.

name: India-Singapore CECA
key_benefits: Tariff elimination for extensive list of products.
origin_criteria: Qualifying Value Content of 40% and Change in Tariff Heading.

name: APTA
key_benefits: Margin of Preference (MoP) on specified tariff lines.
